[!cgo] skip 'cgo is not available'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env CGO_ENABLED=1
env GOEXPERIMENT=

cd cg

# A JSON-tagged struct in a C-importing file: the companion holds
# methods on a cgo-only receiver, so its guard must carry cgo.
# Without it the go tool selects the companion for CGO_ENABLED=0
# builds while excluding the file that defines the receiver.
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
exists out/native.go
exists out/native_jsonv2.go
exec grep -E 'cgo' out/native_jsonv2.go

cd out
go build ./...
go run .
stderr '^native$'
env CGO_ENABLED=0
go build ./...
go run .
! stderr 'native'
stderr '^ok$'
env CGO_ENABLED=1

-- cg/go.mod --
module example.com/cgojson

go 1.27

-- cg/main.lgo --
package main

func main() {
	println("ok")
}

-- cg/native.lgo --
package main

import "C"

func init() { println("native") }

type Native struct {
	Name string `json:"name"`
}
